text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, while out on a walk――

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
A-Ah, wait, wait!! Please, just let me 
floof your fur――

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Wait, ahhh... they're gone... Man, I'm 
completely exhausted from running, and 
yet—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, hey. You over there who just made 
eye contact with me. I've got a question 
for ya!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Uh-huh, uh-huh! How do you think I can get 
that kitty from earlier to let me pet it?
choice_data_list:
Chase them down with everything you've 
got!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Aha, I see. Sunbathing reigns supreme. So 
you're telling me to wait patiently and 
take my time, huh?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Alright then... *yawn*... I shall retire 
for the night... so...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: If a kitty comes... Wake me up... *snooze*

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, in place of the sound-asleep Seiun 
Sky, I ended up waiting for the cat.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Use anything and everything at your 
disposal." Perhaps that's one way to look 
at it. ...Though I can't speak for the 
ones being used.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Yay! Thank you! Then I'll leave it to you 
right away!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Hm? Come on now. Weren't you the one 
who said you'd chase after me~?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I shall stay right here and cheer you on 
with all my heart as you catch that kitty!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ah, right behind that tree over there! 
Come on, do your best! Go for it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, the cat was so agile that 
catching it took quite some effort――

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Unable to catch it in the end, I had to 
ask <chrname> for help as well.
